comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus clear, open, load, and close a sliding-lid glasses box safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires screw-and-nut countertorque; the box task requires sequential pushing and delicate object placement around obstacles.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained calibration and cycling; the box task grades keys in a dish, upright glasses in the box, closed lid, and absence of listed safety violations.
comparison.reason: Fragile-object storage and sliding-lid sequencing do not test preservation of an adjustable mechanical setting.
